AcceptJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_en: Accepts an authorization ticket for a dedicated join permission
AcceptJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_zh: 调用AcceptJoinPermissionAuthOrder接受专用入网凭证授权工单

AddNodeToGroup.description_en: Adds a new node to a node group
AddNodeToGroup.description_zh: 调用AddNodeToGroup在节点分组中增加新的节点

BindJoinPermissionToNodeGroup.description_en: Associates a join permission with a node group by calling BindJoinPermissionToNodeGroup
BindJoinPermissionToNodeGroup.description_zh: 调用BindJoinPermissionToNodeGroup建立入网凭证和节点分组的关联

CancelJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_en: Cancels an authorization ticket for a dedicated join permission by calling CancelJoinPermissionAuthOrder
CancelJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_zh: 调用CancelJoinPermissionAuthOrder取消专用入网凭证授权工单

CountGateways.description_en: Counts the number of gateways that match the specified filter conditions under the current user account
CountGateways.description_zh: 统计当前用户账号名下符合过滤条件的网关数量

CountNodeGroups.description_en: Counts the total number of node groups that match the specified filter conditions
CountNodeGroups.description_zh: 调用CountNodeGroups统计符合过滤条件的节点分组总数

CountNodesByNodeGroupId.description_en: Counts the number of nodes that belong to a specified node group and meet the filter conditions
CountNodesByNodeGroupId.description_zh: 统计某节点分组中且满足过滤条件的节点数量

CountNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId.description_en: Counts the number of nodes that use a specific join permission and meet the filter conditions
CountNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId.description_zh: 统计使用某入网凭证且满足过滤条件的节点的数量

CountNotifications.description_en: Counts the number of notifications that match the specified filter conditions
CountNotifications.description_zh: 调用CountNotifications统计符合过滤条件的通知数量

CountOwnedJoinPermissions.description_en: Counts the number of join permissions owned by the current user account that match the specified filter conditions
CountOwnedJoinPermissions.description_zh: 统计符合过滤条件的当前用户账号所拥有的入网凭证的数量

CountRentedJoinPermissions.description_en: Counts the number of join permissions that are rented by the current user account and match the specified filter conditions
CountRentedJoinPermissions.description_zh: 统计当前用户账号所租用的且符合过滤条件的入网凭证数量

CreateGateway.description_en: Registers a gateway by calling CreateGateway

CreateLocalJoinPermission.description_en: The current user account becomes the owner of the credential and has full ownership of it
CreateLocalJoinPermission.description_zh: 当前用户账号将成为该凭证的拥有者，拥有该凭证

CreateNodeGroup.description_en: Creates a node group by calling CreateNodeGroup

DeleteGateway.description_en: Calls DeleteGateway to delete a registered gateway
DeleteGateway.description_zh: 调用DeleteGateway删除已录入的网关

DeleteLocalJoinPermission.description_en: Deletes a proprietary join permission owned by the current user account
DeleteLocalJoinPermission.description_zh: 调用DeleteLocalJoinPermission删除当前用户账号所拥有的专用入网凭证

DeleteNodeGroup.description_en: Deletes a node group by calling DeleteNodeGroup

GetFreqBandPlanGroup.description_en: Calls GetFreqBandPlanGroup to retrieve frequency band information

GetGateway.description_en: Retrieves gateway information by calling GetGateway

GetGatewayPacketStat.description_en: Retrieves the statistics of valid and invalid packets for a gateway
GetGatewayPacketStat.description_zh: 调用GetGatewayPacketStat获取网关有效包无效包统计

GetGatewayStatusStat.description_en: Retrieves gateway status statistics, such as CPU and memory usage
GetGatewayStatusStat.description_zh: 获取网关状态统计，如 CPU、内存占用等

GetGatewayTransferPacketsDownloadUrl.description_en: The link points to a CSV file that contains statistics on uplink and downlink data packets of the gateway
GetGatewayTransferPacketsDownloadUrl.description_zh: 该链接指向一个CSV文件，其中包括了网关上下行数据包的统计数据

GetJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_en: Retrieves the details of a dedicated join permission authorization order
GetJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_zh: 调用GetJoinPermissionAuthOrder获取专用凭证授权工单的详细信息

GetNode.description_en: Calls GetNode to retrieve node information

GetNodeGroup.description_en: Retrieves node group information by node group ID by calling GetNodeGroup
GetNodeGroup.description_zh: 调用GetNodeGroup根据节点分组ID获取节点分组信息

GetNodeGroupTransferPacketsDownloadUrl.description_en: The link points to a CSV file that contains statistics on uplink and downlink data packets for a node group
GetNodeGroupTransferPacketsDownloadUrl.description_zh: 该链接指向一个CSV文件，其中包括了节点分组上下行数据包的统计数据

GetNotification.description_en: Calls GetNotification to retrieve notification information

GetOwnedJoinPermission.description_en: Retrieves a join permission owned by the current user account based on the join permission ID
GetOwnedJoinPermission.description_zh: 根据入网凭证ID获取当前用户账号所拥有的入网凭证

GetRentedJoinPermission.description_en: Retrieves the details of a rented join permission (either a dedicated or roaming join permission) for the current user account based on the join permission ID
GetRentedJoinPermission.description_zh: 根据入网凭证ID，获取当前用户账号租用的入网凭证（可能是专用入网凭证或泛在入网凭证）

ListActiveGateways.description_en: Queries the gateways that are active today by calling ListActiveGateways
ListActiveGateways.description_zh: 调用ListActiveGateways查询今日活跃网关

ListFreqBandPlanGroups.description_en: Calls ListFreqBandPlanGroups to retrieve the list of frequency bands

ListGatewayOnlineRecords.description_en: Queries the online and offline records of a gateway by calling ListGatewayOnlineRecords
ListGatewayOnlineRecords.description_zh: 调用ListGatewayOnlineRecords查询网关在线离线记录

ListGatewayTransferFlowStats.description_en: Queries the traffic statistics list of a gateway by calling ListGatewayTransferFlowStats
ListGatewayTransferFlowStats.description_zh: 调用ListGatewayTransferFlowStats查询网关流量统计列表

ListGatewayTransferPackets.description_en: Invokes ListGatewayTransferPackets to retrieve the statistics information of uplink and downlink packets of a gateway
ListGatewayTransferPackets.description_zh: 调用ListGatewayTransferPackets获取网关上下行数据包的统计信息

ListGateways.description_en: Queries a list of gateways under the current account based on a conditional query
ListGateways.description_zh: 根据过滤条件查询当前用户账号名下的网关信息列表

ListNodeGroupTransferFlowStats.description_en: Queries the traffic statistics list of a node group by calling ListNodeGroupTransferFlowStats
ListNodeGroupTransferFlowStats.description_zh: 调用ListNodeGroupTransferFlowStats查询节点组流量统计列表

ListNodeGroupTransferPackets.description_en: Invokes ListNodeGroupTransferPackets to retrieve the statistics information of uplink and downlink packets for a node group
ListNodeGroupTransferPackets.description_zh: 调用ListNodeGroupTransferPackets获取节点分组上下行数据包的统计信息

ListNodeGroups.description_en: Queries the list of node groups that match the filter conditions for the current user account
ListNodeGroups.description_zh: 查询当前用户账号的符合过滤条件的节点分组列表

ListNodeTransferPacketPaths.description_en: Retrieves the parallel paths of uplink data packets for a node by calling ListNodeTransferPacketPaths
ListNodeTransferPacketPaths.description_zh: 调用ListNodeTransferPacketPaths获取节点上行数据包的平行路径

ListNodesByNodeGroupId.description_en: Queries the list of nodes in a specified node group based on filter conditions by calling ListNodesByNodeGroupId
ListNodesByNodeGroupId.description_zh: 调用ListNodesByNodeGroupId根据过滤条件，查询指定节点分组中的节点列表

ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId.description_en: Queries the list of nodes that use a specific join permission based on filter conditions by calling ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId
ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId.description_zh: 调用ListNodesByOwnedJoinPermissionId根据过滤条件，查询使用了特定入网凭证的节点列表

ListNotifications.description_en: Calls ListNotifications to retrieve a list of notifications

ListOwnedJoinPermissions.description_en: Queries the list of join permissions owned by the current user account based on a conditional query
ListOwnedJoinPermissions.description_zh: 根据过滤条件查询当前用户账号所拥有的入网凭证列表

ListRentedJoinPermissions.description_en: Queries the list of join permissions rented by the current user account. The join permissions can be dedicated or roaming join permissions
ListRentedJoinPermissions.description_zh: 查询当前用户账号所租用的入网凭证列表（可能是专用入网凭证或泛在入网凭证）

RejectJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_en: Rejects an authorization ticket for a dedicated join permission
RejectJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_zh: 调用RejectJoinPermissionAuthOrder回绝专用入网凭证授权工单

RemoveNodeFromGroup.description_en: Removes a node from a node group by calling RemoveNodeFromGroup
RemoveNodeFromGroup.description_zh: 调用RemoveNodeFromGroup从节点分组中移除节点

ReturnJoinPermission.description_en: Returns a rented join permission (either a dedicated join permission or a ubiquitous join permission)
ReturnJoinPermission.description_zh: 归还租用的入网凭证（可以是专用入网凭证或泛在入网凭证）

SendUnicastCommand.description_en: Sends a unicast command by calling SendUnicastCommand

SubmitJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_en: Submits an authorization order for a dedicated join permission by calling SubmitJoinPermissionAuthOrder
SubmitJoinPermissionAuthOrder.description_zh: 调用SubmitJoinPermissionAuthOrder发起专用入网凭证授权工单

UnbindJoinPermissionFromNodeGroup.description_en: Dissociates a join permission from a node group
UnbindJoinPermissionFromNodeGroup.description_zh: 调用UnbindJoinPermissionFromNodeGroup接触入网凭证和节点分组的关联

UpdateDataDispatchConfig.description_en: Calls UpdateDataDispatchConfig to update the data forwarding configuration of a node group
UpdateDataDispatchConfig.description_zh: 调用UpdateDataDispatchConfig更新节点分组的数据流转配置

UpdateDataDispatchEnablingState.description_en: Enables or disables data forwarding for a node group by calling UpdateDataDispatchEnablingState
UpdateDataDispatchEnablingState.description_zh: 调用UpdateDataDispatchEnablingState启停节点分组的数据流转

UpdateGateway.description_en: Calls UpdateGateway to update gateway information

UpdateGatewayEnablingState.description_en: Enables or disables a gateway by calling UpdateGatewayEnablingState

UpdateNotificationsHandleState.description_en: Updates the handling status of notifications by calling UpdateNotificationsHandleState
UpdateNotificationsHandleState.description_zh: 调用UpdateNotificationsHandleState更新通知的处理状态

UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermission.description_en: Updates a proprietary join permission owned by the current user account
UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermission.description_zh: 调用UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermission更新当前用户账号所拥有的专用入网凭证

UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermissionEnablingSt.description_en: Enables or disables a dedicated join permission owned by the current user account
UpdateOwnedLocalJoinPermissionEnablingSt.description_zh: 启用、停用当前用户账号所拥有的专用入网凭证
